problems.title: Interior and closure in the real line
problems.statement: In $\mathbb R$ with the usual topology, determine the interior and closure of each of the following sets: $A=(0,1]\cup\{2\}$, $B=\mathbb Q$, and $C=\{1/n:n\in\mathbb N\}$. Justify your answers from the definitions.

problems.title: Dense subsets
problems.statement: A subset $A\subseteq X$ is called dense if $\overline A=X$. Prove that $A$ is dense in $X$ if and only if every nonempty open subset of $X$ intersects $A$. Use this characterization to show that $\mathbb Q$ is dense in $\mathbb R$.

problems.title: Closure in a subspace
problems.statement: Let $A\subseteq Y\subseteq X$, where $Y$ has the subspace topology. Write $\overline A^{\,X}$ for the closure of $A$ in $X$ and $\overline A^{\,Y}$ for its closure in $Y$. Prove that $\overline A^{\,Y}=Y\cap\overline A^{\,X}$.
